```{python}
#| label: fig-bench-coordcube-scale
#| fig-cap: "Scale-invariant KV get latency: CoordMap2 vs HashMap"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

labels = ['10k', '1M', '10M']
x = np.arange(len(labels))
w = 0.3

kv2 = [22.0, 21.4, 22.1]
hm  = [21.9, 24.2, 26.5]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4.5, 3.5))
ax.bar(x - w/2, kv2, w, label='CoordMap2', color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8, hatch='///')
ax.bar(x + w/2, hm,  w, label='HashMap',  color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8)

ax.set_ylabel('Latency (ns)', fontsize=9)
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(labels, fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylim(15, 32)
ax.legend(fontsize=8, loc='upper left')
ax.grid(axis='y', linestyle=':', alpha=0.4)

for xi, y1, y2 in zip(x, kv2, hm):
    ax.text(xi - w/2, y1 + 1.0, f'{y1}', fontsize=7, ha='center', va='bottom')
    ax.text(xi + w/2, y2 + 1.0, f'{y2}', fontsize=7, ha='center', va='bottom')

ax.annotate('flat', xy=(1, 21.5), fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', ha='center',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor='white', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.85))
ax.annotate('+21%', xy=(2, 23.0), fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', ha='center',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor='white', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.85))

plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
```
